Chapter 6 - Types, Constants, and Global Functions / Types and Constants
Cyberdog Display Parts

Semantic Events

This section contains semantic events defined by Cyberdog for use by Cyberdog display parts. Semantic events can be passed to a Cyberdog display part's HandleCommand method (page 288).
kCDCmdRefresh
Reconnect to the server and download the data referenced by the display part's Cyberdog item again.
